verdict.rationale: Vanta, a compliance SaaS platform rather than an agent, documents an official Vanta MCP server. It lets AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Perplexity call the Vanta API to query controls and remediate failing tests. It is hosted per region, comes with a quickstart for connecting Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Perplexity, and is backed by a separate docs MCP server. A probe confirms the documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably via the server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Vanta MCP server lets AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Perplexity call the Vanta API on your behalf.
Vanta hosts a separate MCP server in each region. Find the region for your Vanta instance and use that URL.
Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Perplexity to the Vanta MCP server, surface failing tests, and generate a remediation plan for one.
The MCP server at `https://developer.vanta.com/mcp` exposes search over the developer docs and serves every page as a `skill.md` resource.
